body:
Part of General UI Polish (feature item 4, whose text in the feature body is unfinished - it ends at "Consistency in labeling:"). Interpretation: the same thing is named the same way on every page.

- Pick one vocabulary for each control and apply it in `solace_board`, `solace_task`, `strategy` and `settings`: one word for creating a task, one for saving a draft, one for closing notices, one for the scope picker, one for run controls.
- Use the label map built by task b5762697be085893 as the single source, so a name change is one edit.
- Headings, tab names, and the words inside sentences match the control names (e.g. a panel named "Plan" is addressed as "Plan" everywhere).

**Tests:** view tests assert the shared names on each page; tests that asserted the old wording are updated.

**Note for the human:** the feature's item 4 text is incomplete, so this task's scope is my reading of it - confirm or narrow it before a run starts.
title: ui: Consistent labeling pass
